Lina: LumenHealth sent an RFI + security sheet. They want a one-pager capability matrix, a POC SOW, and clarified pricing for a 30-day pilot (Dedicated vs Private with on-prem HSM). Blockers: SSO, HSM attestation, and a <50ms p99 ask for short sequences. Can we turn this around by Thu EOD?
Omar: I'll draft the capability matrix and SLA language. Sam, can you take HSM/KMS wording and notes about attestation requirements?
Sam: Draft HSM blurb below; will upload KMIP snippets to the drive.
```
HSM / KMS (draft):
- Private: customer-managed on-prem HSM via KMIP/PKCS#11. Customer keeps key material; Redwood provides KMIP proxy + integration adapter.
- Dedicated: BYO HSM supported via peered network; Redwood terminates TLS; keys never leave customer HSM.
- Hosted: managed KMS with envelope encryption; HSM-backed key material available as Enterprise feature with attestation reports.
- Note: on-prem HSM throughput and network RTT affect p99; recommend local HSM collocated with inference nodes for <50ms p99.
```
SecBot: Uploaded LumenHealth_Security_Q_2026.xlsx -> https://drive.redwood/internal/lumenhealth/RFI. Checklist mapped.
Priya: POC plan (3 weeks): Week0 NDAs+network checks; Week1 infra + baseline tests; Week2 perf/HSM latency runs + cache tuning; Week3 review + handoff. Acceptance: p99 measured on fixed prompt set.
Omar: Matrix CSV stub (for pack):
```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
SLA,99.9% std,99.95% SLA,Customer-defined
HSM,Managed KMS,BYO HSM,On-prem KMIP
SSO (SAML/OIDC),Yes,Yes,Yes
p99 typical,~40-90ms,~20-45ms,Depends on infra
Model pinning,No,Yes,Yes
Pricing model,Usage,Reserved,License+support
```
Jared: Pricing suggestion: two pilot tracks - "Sandbox" (2 week hosted credits + small dedicated burst) and "Pilot" (30-day dedicated at prorated reserved rate or private trial with integration fee). I'll add numbers once Ops gives costs.
Lina: I'll assemble the RFI pack (capability_matrix.csv, security_answers.docx, poc_sow.md, sample_SOW.pdf) and upload to the drive in ~90m. Ping in-thread for edits. :white_check_mark:
